About Me

Senior Software Engineer, Angular-first, with five years on enterprise platforms in banking, government and retail. My recurring brief is modernisation: legacy AngularJS and ASPX systems taken into current Angular while the business keeps running — most recently a large-scale eBanking platform, and the EuroElections 2024 voting system from Angular 7 to 18. Across the stack when needed — .NET BFF, Node.js, REST APIs, SQL — shipped through Azure DevOps, Jenkins and Docker. Team leader at Cognity.
